items.title: Breaking: Suspected bird flu case detected in NSW
items.description: A suspected positive case of H5 bird flu has been identified in New South Wales, the state agriculture minister has announced.

items.title: Breaking: Firefighters' union loses Supreme Court bid to keep corruption probe secret
items.description: An investigation into allegations of corruption during the tenure of former Victorian premier Daniel Andrews was finished in 2022, but its release has been delayed by court action.

items.title: UK uncovers international network of men drugging and assaulting women
items.description: In echoes of the high-profile Gisele Pelicot case, the National Crime Agency says it has identified more than 270 individuals linked to an online forum and its offshoots.

items.title: Widow warns of shock ambulance bill after husband's unexpected death
items.description: Private health insurers can legally avoid ambulance bills because corpses are not considered patients, a loophole that left a grieving widow shocked.

items.title: Live: Minister defends calling former PM Menzies a 'Nazi appeaser'
items.description: Defence Industry Minister Pat Conroy has doubled down on calling former prime minister Robert Menzies a "Nazi appeaser" at the National Press Club. Follow live.

items.title: Secret police recordings of croc wrangler Matt Wright released
items.description: Secretly recorded phone calls and conversations crucial to the criminal case against celebrity crocodile wrangler Matt Wright during his Northern Territory Supreme Court trial have been released to the media.

items.title: Moira Deeming launches legal action as party meeting on her future looms
items.description: Mrs Deeming has lodged a case against Victorian Liberal Party president Brian Loughnane in the Supreme Court.

items.title: For decades Australian house prices have grown. This is what a fall could mean
items.description: After decades of growth Australian house prices are slowing. Here's what a fall could look like.

items.title: Live: Ronaldo, VAR and snicko rescue Portugal in thriller against Croatia
items.description: Portugal comes from behind, Cristiano Ronaldo scores and Croatia is denied a late equaliser by VAR, while Spain turns on the style to beat Austria 3-0. Follow live.

items.title: Man who spent eight days stuck under collapsed shopping centre in Venezuela rescued alive
items.description: Hernan Alberto Gil Flores, a 43-year-old Venezuelan man was dug out alive from under the ruins of a collapsed shopping centre, eight days after devastating earthquakes shook the nation.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
